svg.title: Leads between the boards and the lid wiring

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Peel a 15-wide and a 10-wide strip off the 40-way female-female jumper ribbon, plus one single lead for pin 16. They plug onto the panel board as TO MAIN A (15), A16 and TO MAIN B (10).

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: At the main board the 15-wide strip is header A as it stands; the 10-wide strip splits into six single pins, the 3-pin piece 17-18-24 and pin 26, which plug onto header B's pieces in any order.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each lead joins the two pins with the same number. The lid hinges on the ribbon edge (the panel board's bottom edge, where header B stands), so both strips cross the hinge together, with slack for the lid to open.

svg.text: With the lever at AUTO, pole 2's middle lug must beep to A, and at HAND to H:

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: check with a meter before soldering, and swap A and H if your switch is the other way round.

svg.text: Six stranded wires about 15 cm long, bundled with a cable tie, from the knob's six tabs to the six

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: KNOB holes. MP is the knob's metal body (either side tab); A and B swapped only reverses the

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: direction, which is one setting in the firmware.

svg.text: Its contact is closed when released: pressing it cuts the pump rail directly. Two stranded 22 AWG leads,

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: twisted, with a service loop near the hinge so the lid opens fully without pulling on the plug.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
